about_the_game:
Season 3: Icy Shores is included in the Year 1 Pass.

Break the ice in Season 3 of Expeditions!

Science never stands still, and researchers need your help once again. Venture further into the remote valleys of the Carpathian Mountains to assist scientists in making new discoveries. Push through thick mud and melting snow, tread carefully along icy riverbanks, and descend into tight Transylvanian caves, in the name of progress.

Season 3: Icy Shores includes:

• A new map in the Carpathians, the Transylvanian Alps, featuring ancient ruins, spring thaw and ice

• A twisting cave system, sheltering impressive geological formations and vestiges of the past

• Three new trucks: the Haukka NS-420, an experimental truck with unmatched off-road performance, the KRS 63 Pathfinder, an eight-wheeled powerhouse capable of handling the harshest conditions, and the TUZ 302 Capricorn, a nimble scouting vehicle

• Two new specialists: a mechanic who can reduce electricity consumption and boost the power and durability of ground drones, and a manager who can increase rewards for each expedition
